df <- data.frame(
  place_names = place_names,
  addresses = addresses,
  urls = urls,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


df$latitude <- str_extract(urls, "(?<=!3d)[0-9\\.]+")
df$longitude <- str_extract(urls, "(?<=!4d)[0-9\\.]+")


# Save the data to a new CSV file
write.csv(df, file = "Data/bytteboxen_with_coordinates.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "WINDOWS-1252")

```{r}

bytteboxen_data <- read.csv("Data/bytteboxen_with_coordinates.csv", fileEncoding = "WINDOWS-1252")



```


```{r}

# Convert the dataframe to a simple feature
sf_data <- st_as_sf(bytteboxen_data, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)  # crs 4326 is for WGS84 (GPS coordinates)

# Save the sf (Note this messes with column names)
st_write(sf_data, "Data/bytteboxen_sf_data.shp")





```



```{r}

sf_data <- read_sf("Data/bytteboxen_sf_data.shp")


```


```{r}

# Generate 5 minute biking isochrones for each location
bytteboxen_isochrones <- lapply(1:nrow(sf_data), function(i) {
  osrmIsochrone(
    loc = st_coordinates(sf_data[i, ]),
    breaks = 5,
    osrm.profile = "bike"
  )
})

# Combine all isochrones into a single sf object
bytteboxen_isochrones_sf <- do.call(rbind, bytteboxen_isochrones)




```

```{r}

# Plotting the generated Bytteboxen isochrones
Bytteboxen_map <- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldStreetMap") %>%
  #addTiles() %>%  # Add a base map
  addPolygons(data = bytteboxen_isochrones_sf, color = "green", weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0.4, group = "Bytteboxen Isochrones") %>%  # bytteboxen isochrones
  addMarkers(data = bytteboxen_data, popup = ~place_names, group = "Byttenboxen Locations") %>%  # Byttenboxen points
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Bytteboxen Isochrones","Bytteboxen Locations"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

saveWidget(Bytteboxen_map, file = "Out/bytteboxen_isochrones.html")




```
